verdict.rationale: TrueLayer's Data API documents access to identity data from integrated banks, and its Verification API compares identity data against the account holder's name, so retrieving owner details to match a customer is a first-party capability. The evidence never lists which identity fields are returned, so only the name is clearly supported. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of address and contact fields (email/phone) in the identity response, field-level schema or coverage by bank, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can retrieve account-holder details — names, addresses, contact data on file at the bank — to match the account owner against my customer

citations.quote: Access identity, accounts, transactions and balance data for all integrated banks with a single interface.
We compare the identity data to the account holder's name for all the connected account(s) the user has given consent for.
Verify that a bank account belongs to a given user.
